record.name: Cloudflare
record.one_liner: Cloudflare provides a cloud platform offering CDN, security, DDoS mitigation, and serverless compute.
record.access_note: Developers can sign up for a free Cloudflare account and generate API tokens or keys directly in the dashboard.
record.api_note: The REST API covers thousands of endpoints across DNS, Workers, Pages, SSL, and other Cloudflare infrastructure.
